title: Floats with an integral value
notes: A float whose value is a whole number still reads back as a float: `1` is an integer under every schema, `1.0` is a float. The writer keeps the point. The Core-schema reading (loose) is the specification. The reading under YAML 1.1 and the number forms that some common readers accept (strict) is a writing convention of the family: a string is written plain only when it reads as that same string there too.
